name: POS Birthday Discount
description: This will auto Apply discount to the customer cart when its their birthday.
summary:
The Birthday Discount in POS module is designed to enhance customer satisfaction and loyalty by providing special discounts automatically on customer birthdays. It integrates seamlessly with the Odoo Point of Sale system, ensuring that birthday-based promotions are applied smoothly without extra effort from cashiers. The module begins by allowing you to store and configure customer birthdates within their contact details. Once set, you can configure the rules for the birthday discount whether it should be a fixed percentage, a specific amount, or applied only under certain conditions. This flexibility gives businesses control over how generous or restrictive they want to be with the birthday reward system. The discount itself is applied automatically to the customer order. Cashiers don’t have to remember or manually select discounts, which reduces mistakes and speeds up transactions. The system ensures that only eligible customers (those with birthdays) receive the discount, making the process efficient and reliable. name: Custom Discounts for Point of Sale
description: Easily apply and manage custom discounts directly in your Odoo POS. This module empowers cashiers and managers to offer flexible price reductions, track discount reasons, and enhance customer satisfaction
summary: The POS Custom Discount app for Odoo is a powerful and user-friendly extension designed to give businesses more flexibility and control over discount management within their Point of Sale operations. Standard POS modules typically provide fixed promotional discounts, but they often lack the ability to create customized offers that meet specific business needs. This app bridges that gap by introducing a Custom Discount feature, allowing POS users to create, apply, and track both predefined and custom discounts directly from the POS interface. With this app, administrators can enable the Custom Discount option from the Odoo backend under the POS settings. Once activated, the POS interface will display a dedicated “Custom Discount” button, alongside any existing discount schemes like seasonal promotions (e.g., “Christmas Offer”) or store milestones (e.g., “Shop 6-Year Completion”). This empowers cashiers or sales staff to either apply predefined discounts to selected order lines or the entire order, or create new custom discounts instantly during checkout. The process is straightforward: after selecting products in the POS cart, the cashier can open the discount dialog to choose from available offers or click on the Custom Discount button to create a new one. The system prompts the user to enter a discount percentage and a reason, ensuring that every custom discount is not only applied correctly but also documented for transparency. Discounts can be applied to individual items (Selected Line) or the entire order (All Line). This ensures maximum flexibility, whether the business wants to promote specific products or reward loyal customers with special order-wide deals. name: Pricelist Restriction
description:
The Pricelist Restriction module enhances pricelist management by limiting access, creation, and editing of pricelists to authorized users only. This ensures better control and security over pricelist configurations.

        Key Features:
        1) User-Specific Pricelist Restriction:
           - Admins can assign specific pricelists to users, restricting access to others.

        2) Restrict Pricelist Creation:
           - Blocks users from creating new pricelists if they belong to the restricted group.

        3) Restrict Pricelist Editing:
           - Prevents users from editing existing pricelists if they are in the restricted group.
